title: Report HTTP resources
responsibility: Serves site-scoped report identity and registered evidence or export files.

inputs.name: reportFile.id
inputs.description: Report identifier that selects the report: it is passed to repository.get(id), used for the report directory of local files, and passed to the R2 get calls for remote files. The handler does not validate its format, so repository.get decides how an unknown id fails.

inputs.name: reportFile.type
inputs.description: Must equal 'assets' exactly: reportFile raises HTTP 404 'Not found' for any other value, including 'exports'. When it is 'assets', it is joined onto the report directory to locate local files.

inputs.name: reportFile.file
inputs.description: Filename matched by exact equality against each evidence entry's file field, and also passed to mediaMime and, for local files, to registeredAsset. A name with no evidence entry raises HTTP 404, and a name whose entries are all missing raises HTTP 410.

inputs.name: reportFile.range
inputs.description: Optional HTTP byte range forwarded unchanged as the third argument of mediaResponse; this file does not parse it. The code declares no default, so it is undefined when a caller omits it, and null is forwarded as-is.

outputs.name: repository
outputs.description: Module-level ReportRepository created once with new SiteReportRepository() and shared by both handlers: reportHttp reads its root, and reportFile calls get and directory on it. The source comment says everything this server serves or changes comes through it, limited to its own site.

outputs.name: reportHttp
outputs.description: SvelteKit json() Response whose JSON body has app 'project-reports', version 1, buildId from reportBuildIdentity(), revision from HARNESS_VERIFY_REVISION (null when unset) and root, a 64-character lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of repository.root. The source comment says only a server started for a verification run knows its revision, so other servers report null, and root is a digest rather than the path itself.

outputs.name: reportFile
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the mediaResponse result: bytes read with readFile from a path returned by registeredAsset, or fetched from R2 for remote evidence, passed with mediaMime(file), the range and the fourth argument 'inline'. The file is served only when at least one evidence entry with that name is not missing; otherwise the promise rejects with HTTP 410 or 404 instead.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with the message 'Cloudflare R2 evidence storage is not configured' when a file is remote with storage 'r2-evidence' and R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.fromEnvironment() returns no adapter. Rejections from repository.get, the R2 get calls, readFile and registeredAsset also propagate, because these files contain no catch.

errors.name: HttpError 404
errors.description: Raised by error(404) with 'Not found' when type is not exactly 'assets', and with 'Evidence expired or unavailable' when no evidence entry has the requested file name. Both cases are raised before any file is read.

errors.name: HttpError 410
errors.description: Raised by error(410) with 'Evidence expired or unavailable' when evidence entries with the requested file name exist but every one of them is marked missing.
